## Requirements (from ticket + spec)
- REQ-DATA-5 materialize: pure fn (project_id, seat, persona_profile_id, run inputs, overlays[]) → tree + `.rhema/manifest.json` (path→artifact_version_id + sha256); per-seat mounts exactly §12.6 tables; manifest.md from tables (REQ-VIS-6); materialize before step 1 + at resume, never mid-phase; read-only paths ro at kernel (P0.06 image, live). preferences.md mount point reserved, never Editor/independence (REQ-OBJ-10).
- REQ-DATA-6 harvest: walk seat writable ns only; hash; version changed/new via path→kind map (unknown default-by-dir or fail); record producerQueryId; identical unversioned; read-only hash check vs manifest → mismatch fails step; write-back diff filtered by write allowlist; out-of-allowlist + immutable-path writes dropped + counted boundary.violation.
- REQ-DATA-7 (amended) delivery transaction: final harvest validates sidecars (P0.04 parsers), cited⇒fetched vs proxy fetch log (every claim.url AND claim.sources[].url), verdict source check (§12.8(c)/REQ-SPEC-25(c)), producer checks; then ONE pg tx: correspondence_item + rows + immutable=true + input-draft freeze + obligation spawn/join hook (logic P0.12; seam here) + timeline event. Validation failure → failed(validation), files partial, nothing immutable. Ledger debit separate retried tx (P0.11).
- REQ-DATA-8 cache: mirror deleted with container; nothing reads a mirror but its owner run.
- REQ-DATA-9 a/c round-trip goldens: materialize+harvest no changes → zero new versions, on the three real projects. (b/d = P1.02/PRB.02.)
- REQ-DATA-10 mount tables.
- REQ-DATA-19/20 attestation: access_report from hydration manifest + proxy request log + subagent launch records (+ in-container audit as secondary attempts); boundary.attested at delivery; iteration caps as orchestrator budgets (audit ≤3, gap ≤3, re-plan ≤2 → completed_partial).
- REQ-DATA-21/24 freeze: freeze on first run-read/dossier-ref/promote/export; v(N+1) origin=human_revision on editing frozen head (API-level).
- REQ-VIS-4 freeze; REQ-VIS-6 manifest derived; REQ-VIS-9 (amended) cited⇒fetched over claim.url + claim.sources[].url against proxy log.
- REQ-ARCH-16 mount=allowlist; REQ-ARCH-20 (amended) attestation from server-side facts; REQ-ARCH-21(c)/REQ-SPEC-25(c) verdict source check.
- REQ-OBJ-8 obligations never mounted into independence contexts; REQ-OBJ-10 preferences.md mount halves; REQ-OBJ-18 delivery-validation half (sources[].url).
- REQ-RUN-3/4 commit protocol (write-back diff, hash check, content-addressed upload).

## Acceptance criteria (→ tests)
1. Golden: materialize+immediate harvest each of 3 real projects → 0 new artifact versions (REQ-DATA-9a). *(det)*
2. Seat-mount: Editor tree has no agents/author/**, no voice-print/lexicon/exemplars, no preferences.md; second read ns exactly [draft]. *(det)*
3. Fixture dossier citing a URL absent from proxy fetch log → failed(validation), partial, nothing immutable; same for a sources[].url. *(det)*
4. chmod+w + edit of a read-only mirror file from agent uid → harvest hash-check fails the step (F14). *(det)*
5. Out-of-allowlist write dropped + counted boundary.violation; >5 violations OR immutable-artifact write quarantines run artifacts (§12.4 boundary class). *(det)*
6. Verdict source check: contradicted Tier-1 verdict citing only a domain reached from inside a fetched page → downgraded unverifiable + sourceCheck:'suspicious_source' at commit; citation-matching domain passes (§12.8(c)). *(det)*
7. access_report fixture: mounted-path counts from manifest, fetch counts from proxy log, subagent scoping listed, denied attempts as secondary count; delivered dossier renders attestation data (REQ-DATA-19). *(det)*
8. Delivery atomicity: induced crash between row insert and freeze rolls back all; retried ledger debit never rolls back a delivered dossier (REQ-DATA-7). *(det)*

## Out of scope
- Gate resolution/overlay creation (P0.10) — consume hydration.overlays[].
- Obligation spawn/discharge/lineage logic (P0.12) — provide transactional hook only.
- Conversion/import of foreign docs (PRB.2); editor schema (P1.02).

## Cross-cutting invariants (re-check before PR)
- Mirror = cache with signed contract, never a 2nd source of truth (REQ-DATA-8).
- "Never mounted" provable; "never read" not — attestation only from server-side facts.
- Delivered artifacts immutable; freeze one-way (REQ-VIS-4/5).

## Plan (Phase 1)
Baseline GREEN: build/lint/typecheck clean; 632 tests pass.

**New package `@rhema/mirror` (packages/mirror)** — pure + DI'd; deps contracts/db/engine/hooks/protocols.
- `sql.ts` structural `SqlExecutor {query(sql,params?)}` (no orchestrator dep, like egress-proxy).
- `content-store.ts` `ContentStore{get(sha),put(sha,bytes)→{key}}`, `sha256Hex`, `s3KeyFor(ws,sha)`, `InMemoryContentStore`.
- `mounts.ts` reuse `SEAT_MOUNTS` (@rhema/hooks); `matchesMountGlob`, `seatReadWriteGlobs(seat)`.
- `materialize.ts` `materializeSeat(exec,store,args)→MirrorTree{files,manifest,manifestMd}` — read artifacts+head versions, filter by SEAT_MOUNTS[seat] (Editor excludes author/voice/preferences by construction), apply overlays[], fetch content, build `.rhema/manifest.json` + `manifest.md` (REQ-VIS-6). Also `materializeScoped(role,inputs)` reusing engine `enumerateScopedFiles` (second read = [draft]).
- `manifest.ts` MirrorManifest types + `renderManifestMd`.
- `harvest.ts` `harvest(exec,store,args)→HarvestResult` — write-back diff vs manifest; read-only hash check (mismatch→readOnlyHashMismatch, fails step, AC4); writable-namespace changed/new → version via `pathToKind` (unknown→fail); identical unversioned; out-of-allowlist + immutable-path writes dropped+counted boundary.violation; quarantine if >5 or any immutable write (AC5).
- `validation.ts` `validateSidecars` (parsers), `validateCitedFetched` (claim.url + sources[].url vs fetch_log normalized_url, AC3), `verdictSourceCheck` (Tier-1 verified/contradicted downgrade→unverifiable+suspicious_source unless registrable domain matches citation / reputable list / from_search, AC6), `registrableDomain`, `checkSecondReadProducer`.
- `attestation.ts` `buildAccessReport(exec,args)` from run_mounts (mounted-path counts+by_top_level) + fetch_log (fetches+denied) + subagent_launches (scoping) + access_log (secondary attempts); `accessReportEvent`→boundary.attested payload; `renderAccessReportMd` (AC7).
- `delivery.ts` `ObligationHook` seam (default no-op; P0.12) + `runDeliveryTransaction(exec,deps,args)`: insert correspondence_item+claims+claim_sources+findings, mark delivered versions immutable, freeze input draft, obligation hook, append boundary.attested + run.report. Validation failure surfaced by caller as failed(validation).
- `freeze.ts` `freezeDraft`, `openHumanRevision` (v(N+1) origin=human_revision).
- `testing/` InMemoryContentStore + `seedMirrorFixture(db,store)` (real content+sha for proj_pv/proj_sd/proj_cr) + PGlite reuse.

**Migration 0009** (additive): `run_mounts(run_id,attempt,seat,manifest jsonb,materialized_at,pk(run_id,attempt))` (persisted hydration manifest = attestation fact) + `subagent_launches(id,run_id,attempt,label,model,inputs_kind,input_paths[],file_count,producer_query_id,launched_at)`. Enforcement-style (ref runs, not RLS), grant rhema_app/rhema_harvester. Drizzle tables in enforcement.ts (schema-parity requires both directions).

**Orchestrator** `delivery.ts` `deliverRun(deps,args)`: validate → tx{runDeliveryTransaction + applyTransition(finalizing→completed) + ledger.release + revoke + cost.final} else failRun(finalizing→failed,'validation'). Debit stays separate (per-step). Persist hydration manifest via `recordMounts` at hydrate. Export + dep + tsconfig ref.

### Test matrix (AC → test)
1. AC1 round-trip: `seedMirrorFixture` each of proj_pv/proj_sd/proj_cr → materializeSeat → harvest(no changes) → newVersions=[] (mirror/materialize.test or roundtrip.test).
2. AC2 seat-mount: materializeSeat(editor) tree has no agents/author/**, no voice-print/lexicon/exemplars, no preferences.md; materializeScoped('second-reader') = [draft] (reuse engine enumerateScopedFiles).
3. AC3 cited⇒fetched: claim.url absent from fetch_log → validateCitedFetched fails → deliverRun→failed(validation), partials, nothing immutable; same for sources[].url.
4. AC4 read-only hash: manifest read-only file whose harvested bytes differ → readOnlyHashMismatch → step fails.
5. AC5 allowlist: write to out-of-allowlist path dropped+boundary.violation; >5 → quarantine; immutable-path write → quarantine.
6. AC6 verdict source: contradicted Tier-1 citing only in-page-link domain → downgraded unverifiable+suspicious_source; citation-matching domain passes.
7. AC7 access_report: buildAccessReport counts from run_mounts + fetch_log + subagent_launches + access_log; accessReportEvent payload; delivered dossier writes access_report artifact.
8. AC8 atomicity: obligation hook throws after correspondence insert → tx rollback (no correspondence, draft still working); separate ledger debit tx failing never rolls back the delivered correspondence.
